title: UAV-X run record
description: Provenance contract for runs/*.jsonl. Round 2 finding 5: nothing tied runs/latest.jsonl to the scenario that had just run, so a stale green file survived a crashed simulation and a metrics writer that never saw a vehicle could satisfy a gate. uavx_eval.check validates this block before reading any metric. A metric can only be trusted after its provenance is. Round 3 finding 6: packet counts and injected events were optional, and there was no duration, so a short run with no events could satisfy every requirement. They are required now.

run_id.description: Unique per run. The filename is runs/<run_id>.jsonl.

scenario_path.description: Repo-relative path of the scenario. The checker rejects a mismatch against what the gate asked for, which is what stops a previous scenario's record passing a later gate.

scenario_sha256.description: Hash of the scenario file as actually read, so an edited scenario cannot reuse an old result.

seed.description: RNG seed taken from the scenario. Same seed and same commit must reproduce the run exactly.

completion.description: Only 'complete' is accepted. latest.jsonl is published by atomic rename after every process exits cleanly, never by append.

vehicle_ids_observed.description: Must match the scenario's vehicle list. A run that saw two of four vehicles is not the run the gate asked for.

pose_sample_count.description: Zero means nothing was ever observed, which is how 'no samples' masquerades as 'no separation violations'.

app_packets_sent_by_node.description: Denominators. A zero denominator makes any ratio meaningless and is rejected rather than treated as 1.0.

delivered_hops_by_node.description: Mean hop count of DELIVERED APPLICATION packets only. HELLO and LSA traffic must not be counted; including it lets a swarm with no relaying show a hop count above 1.

injected_events.description: Every event the scenario asked for, with the time it was actually observed. An event that never fired fails the gate instead of leaving a default reconnect time in place.

versions.description: Every ENFORCED key from stage-1/setup/versions.lock, read at run time. Round 4 finding 8: this block named four of them, so a run could be labelled with an incomplete version object and attributed to a stack it did not come off. The ROS middleware version belongs here more than most: rmw_fastrtps carries every message this project measures. The observed_ keys in the lock are context for a human and are deliberately not required.

metrics.description: The numbers the gates assert on. Present only after every provenance field above has validated.

requested_duration_s.description: Duration the scenario asked for. Without it a 20 second run can send the minimum packet count and claim completion instead of running the frozen duration.

elapsed_sim_s.description: Simulated time actually elapsed. uavx_eval.check rejects a run shorter than 95% of requested_duration_s.

source_tree_sha256.description: Hash of the source that can change what a simulation does, from scripts/source_tree_hash.py: uavx_ws/, scenarios/, scripts/ and stage-1/setup/. Deliberately narrower than the repository, so editing a sentence of prose does not invalidate a week of runs, and deliberately wider than commit_sha, which ignores uncommitted code. W5 requires this to equal the source_tree_sha256 in submission/source-manifest.json, which is what ties the evidence to the code being submitted.

contact_monitor_samples.description: Zero contacts means nothing if no monitor was attached. The safety gate requires this above zero.
